environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No AWS WAF association. ALB access logs enabled to S3 but no real-time alerting. Application runs as systemd service under app user. SQLite database at /var/lib/app/users.db with production data.

config.alb: internet-facing, default forwarding rule, no WAF association
